validation_boundary: The authoritative ATOM Pydantic model, sufficiency validator, JSON Schema, and exact SEA v4 compact protocol were not directly retrievable in this session. Structural and serialization checks therefore use a strict local Pydantic contract and generated JSON Schema reconstructed from recent validated project guideline artifacts, together with the retrieved large-source guideline guardrail. This report does not claim execution of unavailable authoritative project code.

consistency_review.finding: All 146 guideline recommendation identifiers were captured once. The six graded recommendations retain their Level 2 grades and evidence certainty in tags. The bibliography skips reference number 509 in the supplied source. The companion article contains a malformed access-date string in reference 25. Neither source issue was silently corrected.

schema_gaps: The project LiteratureAtom pattern used for recent guideline outputs has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind. Formal guidance is serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags.
Recommendation strength and GRADE certainty are preserved in tags rather than dedicated typed fields.
The guideline's reports of underlying trials and observational studies are secondary evidence. Primary-study atoms require separate extraction of the cited primary publications.
The companion CJASN application article is a separate publication. It is represented in SEA and the reference artifact rather than being forced into the guideline publication_id.
extraction_limitations: Canonical statements normalize PDF line-wrap hyphenation, ligatures, and heading carryover without adding unreported clinical details.

The 2017 guideline's systematic search ended in September 2014 and was supplemented by work-group evidence through January 2017. No external 2026 currency check was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
Many recommendations are ungraded by design. Structural validity of an atom does not imply high certainty of the underlying clinical evidence.
All atoms remain needs_review because no independent human source verification step is represented.
Biographic disclosures and every cited study result were not atomized. The focus is the guideline's own recommendations, methods, scope, and explicit limitations.
